about: Round 55 (should): what a policy set's status becomes and whether it still takes part in decisions after a status change: a lifecycle transition, a re-upload or an import with another status or none, a customization. Each case runs in a tenant of its own, reads the export first and last, and decides after every write on operations that only one set, policy or rule allows; a control uploads an ACTIVE set and decides first and last. Every step that decides is followed by both raw reads of the v3 export, policySets and pips. They were added after the round was recorded, so that the export-fed profile can compare most decisions with legacy.
